€1P. (तङ्कति, तङ्कित) 
__1 To endure, bear. 
__2 To laugh. 
__3 To live in distress.

[तङ्क् भावे अच्] 
__1 Living in distress, a miserable life. 
__2 Grief produced by separation from a beloved object. 
__3 Fear, terror. 
__4 A stone-cutter's chisel. 
__5 A garment.

€1P. (तङ्गति, तङ्गित) 
__1 To go, move. 
__2 To shake, tremble. 
__3 To stumble.
